page.layout: Two coin illustrations at the top, side by side (no printed text outside the cuts). Below them one column of running text in two paragraphs, full width. A tailpiece ornament at the foot. No marginal notes. Printed page number at the head left, running head at the head centre.

main_text.l: CVNRADVS Ludouici, Arnulphi filij, ex fratre nepos,,
ultimus ex nobilissima posteritate Caroli Magni, Germaniæ
Rex, Cæsar designatur anno mundi 4873. à Christo nato 911.
nec tamen à Pontifice coronatur. Hic Hungaros, quos instigarat
Berengarius (qui Imperatoris sibi nomen in Italia usurpabat)
ut iterum Germaniam depopularentur, superauit, Othonis
Saxonũ ducis præsidio: cuius filius Henricus à Cunrado mori-
turo Imperator declaratur. Consulito Chron.
HENRICVS Saxonum Dux, supradicti Othonis filius,
in Germanorum imperio succedit, defuncto Cunrado anno
mundi 4881. à Christo nato 919. tum imperium à Caroli magni
posteris ad Saxones translatum est. Hic Hungaros vicit, Scla-
uos subegit, Dalmatas tributarios fecit: Boemos imperij legi-
bus subiecit, quadragintamillia Hungarorum apud Meresbur-
gum prostrauit: Brādeburgum cepit. Vandalos subegit ad mare
usque (hi Christiana religionem tunc amplexi sunt) toti Ger-
maniæ summam tranquillitatē peperit: hic cognomēto auceps,
iam morti proximus successorem imperij instituit Othonem
filium suum, cū ipse imperasset annos octodecim. Vide Liuthp.
lib. 2. ca. 9, Vuitich. lib. 1.

page.notes: The two coin cuts carry legends: left "IMP.CONRADVS" and "P.F.AVG." (Conradus), right "D.N.HENRICVS P.F.AVG." (Henricus). These are part of the illustrations and are not transcribed as text. Running head middle letter is partly obscured; read as PROMPTV[?] ICONVM. The signature at the foot is faint and uncertain. Show-through text in the lower half of the page is excluded.
